name: OneDrive
description: Read documents from a user's OneDrive for Business via Microsoft Graph API using existing SharePoint credentials.

config_variables.name: OD_ID_APP
config_variables.label: App Client ID
config_variables.placeholder: Enter Azure AD app client ID

config_variables.name: OD_ID_APP_SECRET
config_variables.label: App Client Secret
config_variables.placeholder: Enter Azure AD app client secret

tools.name: list_documents
tools.documentation: List documents in the user's OneDrive. Lists from OD_FOLDER if configured, otherwise from root.

tools.name: get_document_content
tools.documentation: Get document content from OneDrive by file name or item ID. .docx returns extracted plain text, .pdf returns extracted plain text, .md returns plain text, others return Base64.
